default.description: Default scenario - returns standard mock data

error_not_found.description: Returns not found errors for queries

slow_response.description: Adds 2 second delay to all responses

very_slow.description: Adds 5 second delay to all responses

large_dataset.description: Returns large datasets for performance testing

datatypes.description: Returns data with various SQL data types for type handling testing

template_stream.description: Template-based data generation with configurable rows and pause patterns

template_million.description: 1 million records with 20ms pause between pages of 1000

template_partial_error.description: Returns 50 rows then includes an error (simulates connection timeout)

template_partial_500.description: Returns 100 rows then includes a server error

partialError.message: Internal server error: query execution interrupted

template_all_features.description: Template rows + pauses + partial error combined

truncated_response.description: Server crash - returns truncated/malformed JSON after 10 rows

truncated_mid_stream.description: Server crash mid-stream - truncates after 50 rows with pauses

perf_100.description: Performance: 100 rows, no pauses — baseline throughput

perf_1k.description: Performance: 1,000 rows, no pauses — medium throughput

perf_10k.description: Performance: 10,000 rows, no pauses — large throughput

perf_50k.description: Performance: 50,000 rows, no pauses — stress throughput

perf_mixed_types.description: Performance: 1,000 rows with all column types — type conversion cost

perf_long_stream.description: Performance: 600 rows, 1s pause per row — ~10 min long-running stream

perf_jittery.description: Performance: 1,000 rows with simulated network jitter pauses

perf_500k.description: Performance: 500,000 rows, no pauses — near-million row stress test

perf_soak_slow_server.description: Soak: 5,000 rows, server sends 1 row then pauses 500ms — ~42 min sustained slow drip

perf_soak_medium.description: Soak: 10,000 rows, 100ms pause every 10 rows — ~17 min steady stream

perf_chunk_gap_35s.description: Timeout probe: 100 rows, 35s pause every 10 rows — will exceed default 30s read timeout mid-stream

perf_chunk_gap_25s.description: Timeout probe: 100 rows, 25s pause every 10 rows — just under default 30s read timeout

perf_soak_1h_drip.description: Soak 1h: 3,600 rows, 1 row/sec — steady drip for exactly 1 hour

perf_soak_1h_burst.description: Soak 1h: 36,000 rows in bursts of 100, then 10s pause — ~1 hour with bursty traffic

perf_soak_1h_mixed.description: Soak 1h: 3,600 mixed-type rows, 1 row/sec — type conversion under sustained load

perf_soak_1h_firehose.description: Soak 1h: 360,000 rows with 10ms pause per row — sustained high-volume streaming for ~1 hour

perf_soak_1h_firehose_mixed.description: Soak 1h: 360,000 mixed-type rows with 10ms pause per row — heavy type conversion under volume
